assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意；相关管控条件属于组织方数据缺口，未虚构。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only; the gap is organizer-side and is not fabricated.

assumptions.statement_zh: 品牌在先权利：概念阶段未完成官方商标检索，「视觉识别智环」「VIS·JZ」及节点名称一律按内部工作代号处理，限制对外使用与注册，待在先权利检索与正式评选确定后评估；本方案不作「不涉及商标」类自证声明。
assumptions.statement_en: Trademark position: no official trademark search at concept stage; all names and marks are internal working codenames, restricted from external use and registration until clearance; no bare 'no trademark involved' self-declaration is made.

assumptions.statement_zh: 全部指标为参与者临时模型数据，非权威数据；与公告口径一致处按公告自算、非官方核发；官方数据发布后整体复算并标注复算版本。
assumptions.statement_en: All metrics are participant provisional model data, not authoritative data; statements consistent with the announcement are self-calculated; full recalculation follows official data release.

assumptions.statement_zh: 主视台、导视廊与叙视厅三节点均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺；可逆公共空间组件库与荣誉展示系统为概念性机制建议。
assumptions.statement_en: The three nodes are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments; the reversible component library and honor display system are concept-level mechanisms.

assumptions.statement_zh: 视觉识别专项的 AI 场景仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底：仅匿名聚合数据、关键决策人工复核、禁止过度监控（不进行个体识别式追踪（含视觉识别）），不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: AI scenarios process anonymized aggregates only, with human review of key decisions and no excessive monitoring (no individual-identification tracking, including visual recognition); no auto-decision without human termination.

assumptions.statement_zh: 视觉识别开放日、视觉体验周、季度导视更新通报与叙视厅文化节等年度活动均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The annual programme system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.
